## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Yuttihāravibhaṅga* ("Conveying a Construing: Analysis") is a section of the *Nettippakaraṇa* (Ne 6) [SuttaCentral]. In the hermeneutical method set out in the work, the category of "construing" (*yuttihāra*) serves to determine the aptness or otherwiseness of a particular phenomenon [Khemananda 1993]. SuttaCentral records one modern translation in English [SuttaCentral].
SuttaCentral identifies passage-level parallels between the *Yuttihāravibhaṅga* and the *Peṭakopadesa* (*Ariyasaccappakāsanapaṭhamabhūmi*, Pe 1) as well as within the *Netti* itself (*Vevacanahāravibhaṅga*, Ne 13) [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral also notes cross-references or mentions connected to the *Attahatasutta* (SN 1.66), the *Attadaṇḍasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 15), the *Sirimaṇḍattheragāthā* (Thag 6.13), and the *Tissasutta* (SN 22.84) [SuttaCentral].
According to DharmaNexus, the text exhibits extensive Pali-internal text reuse (609 matches across 30 texts), sharing substantial material not only with its commentary (*Nettippakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā*) and subcommentaries (*Nettivibhāvinī*, *Nettippakaraṇa-ṭīkā*), but also with canonical collections [DharmaNexus]. Its most significant shared passages appear in the *Khandha Saṁyutta* (SN 22), the *Navakanipāta* (AN 9), the *Ñāṇakathā* of the *Paṭisambhidāmagga* (Ps 1.1), the *Ñāṇavibhaṅga* (Vb 16), the *Paṭiccasamuppādavibhaṅga* (Vb 6), and the *Saṅgīti Sutta* (DN 33) [DharmaNexus]. In cross-language automated alignments, DharmaNexus detects text reuse matches with the Tibetan translation of the *Udānavargavivaraṇa* and the Sanskrit *Daśasāhasrikā Prajñāpāramitā* [DharmaNexus].
